content:
maria: Heads up — during kitsune-v1 bring-up we see a localized quality regression on the vertical Han/Hanja translation set after QAT->int6 quant. Quick summary: baseline fp16 BLEU=32.1, kitsune-int6 BLEU=27.8 (on same test split). Also observed RTL bracket mirror flip for some Arabic annotations in mixed-orient samples.

jong: ouch. can you paste the eval command + exact metric output?

maria: eval command below (ran on ci-evals):

```\n# repro snippet\npython tools/eval_translate.py \\  --model=kitsune-v1:quant=int6:config=fast-bf16 \\  --testset=data/vertical_hanja_mixed_orient.jsonl \\  --metrics=bleu,chrf,em,align-coverage \\  --batch=64 --max-len=512\n```

maria: metrics (full run): BLEU=27.8, chrF=44.6, EM=0.62, align-coverage=0.87. Baseline-fp16: BLEU=32.1, chrF=48.9, EM=0.68. eval-bot: automated-diff: {"bleu": "-4.3", "chrf": "-4.3", "em": "-0.06"} (p<0.01).

li: can you paste a minimal failing example? is it tokenization shift or LM scoring?

maria: sample (src / ref / kitsune-int6):
src: "縦書きの見出し：漢字（漢字表記）［注釈］"
ref: "縦書きの見出し：漢字（注釈）［参考］"
kitsune-int6: "縦書きの見出し：漢字（漢字表記）［参考］"

maria: note the parentheses content got duplicated/shifted; also in mixed Arabic+Han samples we saw a trailing bracket mirrored on RTL segments.

li: hmm that looks like a token boundary reattachment in the detokenized output. Did tokenization mapping change for vertical orientation?

maria: verified tokenizer mapping file used for quant build: token_map_v2.json (same as fp16). But the quant pipeline applied a post-detok merge in the runtime to save tokens — suspect KVCACHE prefix handling for vertical layout.

ash: assigning myself to bisect. I'll run shadow-int6 with the following variants: (A) int6 kernels + original detok; (B) int6 + runtime-detok-merge-disabled; (C) int6 + old kvcache flush.

ash: ETA 2 hours. can someone add the failing test to the regression harness (ci/regress/vertical_hanja.jsonl)? @jong @li

jong: added test to harness (PR #3421). also kicked a smaller sample run on bench1 to repro quickly.

eval-bot: quick-smoke (subset): kitsune-int6-subset BLEU=28.1 -> baseline-fp16-subset BLEU=32.4. diffs same direction.

li: if detok merge is the culprit, we might be miscounting fullwidth punctuation as detachable tokens in vertical layout. i'll grep for zenkaku punctuation handlers.

maria: also noticed weird RTL bracket mirroring: example src (mixed): "שלום (注)》漢字" -> kitsune produced closing double-angle on Arabic side. That points at bidirectional anchor getting applied after character-level detok.

ash: plan: reproduce, then run kernel toggles to see when BLEU recovers. if it's only runtime detok, we can gate the merge behind a locale-aware flag.

maria: action items: 1) ash to bisect and post diff + commit hash; 2) li to audit detok/tokenizer mapping for vertical orientation; 3) jong to keep regression harness + add a small human inspection set.

jong: noted. will also run a chrF-focused analysis since BLEU is length-sensitive for vertical line-wrapping.

maria: thanks — please drop updates here. :pray:

ash: starting bisect now (kicks at 1769876550). will post intermediate hashes and small sample outputs when available.

maria: tagging rf: potential P0 for kitsune-int6 on multilang onboards if regression persists.

(END)
